in_sanskrit.name: Pyarelal
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Loved by God
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Pyarelal एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। A name derived from 'Pyare' meaning loved and 'Lal' meaning God. It signifies being loved by the divine.

in_hindi.name: प्यारेलाल
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who is beloved and has a red complexion.

in_marathi.name: Pyarelal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Loved by God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pyarelal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from 'Pyare' meaning loved and 'Lal' meaning God. It signifies being loved by the divine.

in_bengali.name: Pyarelal
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Loved by God
in_bengali.long_meaning: Pyarelal একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। A name derived from 'Pyare' meaning loved and 'Lal' meaning God. It signifies being loved by the divine.
